title: 云厂商加速AI代理与主权云基础设施布局，SaaS行业深化垂直应用与自动化
core_insight: AI代理基础设施正从概念验证走向企业级应用，同时云厂商通过边缘AI、主权云和模块化数据中心应对监管与算力分散需求，标志着云计算向智能化、合规化和去中心化演进

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出S3 Files将对象存储转换为高性能文件系统；Google Cloud推出QueryData工具实现自然语言到数据库查询的精准转换；Cloudflare推出基于Astro 6.0的全栈无服务器JavaScript CMS EmDash；微软在KubeCon Europe 2026展示Kubernetes运营成熟度进展 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL推出秒级创建的Serverless数据库配置；ECS Managed Daemons增强容器编排的监控和日志管理能力；Cloudflare网络容量突破500Tbps；微软推进Agentic AI与数据库融合 Launching S3 Files, making S3 buckets accessible as file systems QueryData helps agents turn natural language into queries for AlloyDB, Cloud SQL and Spanner Introducing EmDash — the spiritual successor to WordPress that solves plugin security What’s new with Microsoft in open-source and Kubernetes at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Europe 2026 Announcing Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL serverless database creation in seconds 500 Tbps of capacity: 16 years of scaling our global network Raising the security baseline: Essential AI and cloud security now on by default 字节跳动是如何建设云的？ Announcing managed daemon support for Amazon ECS Managed Instances Introducing Programmable Flow Protection: custom DDoS mitigation logic for Magic Transit customers
